preset.vless_custom.description: Build non-stock VLESS: transport × tls/reality/plain + flow/path/ALPN. Lab; check Vision↔transport compatibility.
preset.vless_custom.title: VLESS constructor
preset.vless_grpc_reality.description: Reality + gRPC. H2 shape after Reality; service_name is a tunable marker.
preset.vless_grpc_reality.title: VLESS gRPC Reality
preset.vless_grpc_tls.description: TLS + gRPC/H2 (ALPN h2). Good demux TLS slot with its own SNI/.local.
preset.vless_grpc_tls.title: VLESS gRPC TLS
preset.vless_http_reality.description: Reality + HTTP transport. Reality outside, H2 path inside.
preset.vless_http_reality.title: VLESS HTTP Reality
preset.vless_http_tls.description: TLS + HTTP/2 transport. Post-TLS looks like H2; keep host/path plausible.
preset.vless_http_tls.title: VLESS HTTP TLS
preset.vless_httpupgrade_reality.descrip: Reality + HTTPUpgrade. Same as HUp TLS with Reality fingerprint.
preset.vless_httpupgrade_reality.title: VLESS HTTPUpgrade Reality
preset.vless_httpupgrade_tls.description: TLS + single HTTP Upgrade (no WS framing). Lighter than WS; path still visible to proxies.
preset.vless_httpupgrade_tls.title: VLESS HTTPUpgrade TLS
preset.vless_hysteria_tls.description: VLESS + transport=hysteria (HY auth over QUIC/H3). Not type:hysteria2.
preset.vless_hysteria_tls.title: VLESS Hysteria TLS
preset.vless_quic_tls.description: VLESS + transport=quic (UDP). Not Hy2 — V2Ray QUIC stack.
preset.vless_quic_tls.title: VLESS QUIC TLS
preset.vless_reality.description: Reference TCP:443: VLESS + Reality. ClientHello mimics a pooled site — strong vs DPI and active probe.
preset.vless_reality.title: VLESS Reality
preset.vless_tcp.description: VLESS without TLS. LAN/lab only — trivial on public DPI.
preset.vless_tcp.title: VLESS TCP
preset.vless_tls.description: VLESS + classic TLS (ACME/self-signed). Simpler than Reality; weaker vs probing and SNI blocks.
preset.vless_tls.title: VLESS TLS
preset.vless_tls_mux.description: VLESS+TLS with smux+padding: fewer handshakes, different timing. Not a Reality replacement.
preset.vless_tls_mux.title: VLESS TLS + mux
preset.vless_ws_reality.description: Reality outside + WS inside. Reality fingerprint; path still required by front/CDN.
preset.vless_ws_reality.title: VLESS WS Reality
preset.vless_ws_tls.description: WebSocket upgrade after TLS. Fits CDN/nginx; path/Host are post-TLS fingerprints.
preset.vless_ws_tls.title: VLESS WS TLS
